name: GeoDrop
one_liner: Build proprietary, timestamped installed-base reality data where public maps are insufficient.
core_thesis: As cognition and public-data transformation commoditize, verified observations of difficult-to-reconstruct physical installed base can retain value. GeoDrop should focus narrowly on asset classes where a buyer cares about what physically exists now and public sources are incomplete, stale or ambiguous.
why_now: Agents make broad aggregation cheap, increasing the relative value of hard verification and longitudinal physical-state data.
user: Buyer, operator, investor, installer or supplier making an installed-base decision
job: Know what physical assets actually exist, where, in what state and when.
distribution: Decision-specific reports/API first; broader graph only after paid/useful slices exist.
moat: Verified longitudinal physical observations and buyer-linked outcomes, not map software.
falsifiers: Public data is already sufficient for the target buyer decision.
Verification cost exceeds willingness to pay.
Observations decay too quickly to maintain economically.
success_definition: A real user makes a better decision because of proprietary verified physical-state data.

repo_binding.polling: Bind a repo only when implementation exists; repository state is never behavioral proof.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
software_substitution_test.rationale: Public geodata is replicable. Repeated verified observations of what physical assets actually exist, where, in what state and when can become proprietary reality data.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Create the first decision-useful verified installed-base slice
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Choose one country/region and one asset class (initial example: UK EV charging hardware). Verify a small set of installations with timestamped source/evidence and expose a query a buyer could actually use.

steps.action: Freeze one asset class, geography and buyer decision
steps.acceptance: No broad country graph; one decision question only.

steps.action: Independently verify a subset through second source/human/operator evidence
Put one useful query/report in front of a real potential buyer
steps.acceptance: Usefulness/WTP outcome attaches to dataset slice.

underengineer.graduation_rule: A buyer/user makes a decision using data that was materially better because of proprietary verification.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If public directories already answer the buyer question at sufficient quality, move to a harder-to-observe asset class or stop.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.
